e.body: Artemis.bm 是**巨灾债券与保险连结证券（ILS）市场的行业标杆情报与数据源**，覆盖范围包括 Catastrophe Bonds & ILS、ILS Funds & Managers、Reinsurance Renewals、**Retrocession（转分保）**、**Parametric Insurance（参数化保险）**、**Reinsurance Sidecars（侧车）**、**Industry Loss Warranty（ILW）**、Casualty ILS、**Cyber Cat Bonds & ILS**、Longevity Risk Transfer（长寿风险转移）、Weather Risk Management、Climate Change & Climate Risk、Protection Gap（保障缺口）、Alternative Reinsurance Capital 等专题。除新闻外，它的**数据类栏目**才是对精算与风险分析最有价值的部分：**Deal Directory**（逐笔巨灾债券/ILS 交易目录）、**Cat Bond & ILS Market Dashboard**（市场规模演进）、**Catastrophe Bond Market Yield**（市场收益率曲线）、**Cat Bond Losses & Bonds At Risk**（触发与在险债券追踪）、Reinsurance Sidecars、**Longevity Swaps & Risk Transfers**、**Reinsurance Market Survey Results**、MarketView 与 ILS Fund Managers 名录。对 RIAA：这是理解**「风险如何被资本市场化」**的第一手窗口——巨灾债券把保险风险打包成可交易证券，是保险与资本市场交叉的核心机制；定价与建模侧可接 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[climada-petals]]，市场与行业数据可与 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[perils-ied]] 对照，巨灾模型侧见 [[catmodeling]]、[[oasislmf]]，参数化产品设计见 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]；适合作 ILS、巨灾风险转移、资本管理与行业研究（含面试谈资）方向。
e.body_en: Artemis.bm is **the benchmark intelligence and data source for the catastrophe bond and insurance-linked securities (ILS) market**. Its coverage spans Catastrophe Bonds & ILS, ILS Funds & Managers, Reinsurance Renewals, **retrocession**, **parametric insurance**, **reinsurance sidecars**, **Industry Loss Warranty (ILW)**, casualty ILS, **cyber cat bonds & ILS**, longevity risk transfer, weather risk management, climate change & climate risk, the protection gap and alternative reinsurance capital. Beyond news, its **data sections** are what matters most for actuarial and risk analysis: the **Deal Directory** (deal-by-deal cat bond / ILS records), the **Cat Bond & ILS Market Dashboard** (market size over time), **Catastrophe Bond Market Yield** (market yield series), **Cat Bond Losses & Bonds At Risk** (triggers and exposed bonds), reinsurance sidecars, **longevity swaps & risk transfers**, **reinsurance market survey results**, MarketView and an ILS investment manager directory. For RIAA: a first-hand window onto **how risk is capitalised** — cat bonds package insurance risk into tradable securities, a core mechanism where insurance meets capital markets; for pricing and modelling connect [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[cat-bond-pricer]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] and [[climada-petals]]; market and industry data can be read against [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[perils-ied]]; for the catastrophe model side see [[catmodeling]] and [[oasislmf]], and for parametric product design see [[parametric-insurance-demo]]; suits ILS, catastrophe risk transfer, capital management and industry research (including interview preparation).
e.body_hk: Artemis.bm 是**巨災債券與保險連結證券（ILS）市場的行業標杆情報與數據源**，覆蓋範圍包括 Catastrophe Bonds & ILS、ILS Funds & Managers、Reinsurance Renewals、**Retrocession（轉分保）**、**Parametric Insurance**、**Reinsurance Sidecars**、**Industry Loss Warranty（ILW）**、Casualty ILS、**Cyber Cat Bonds & ILS**、Longevity Risk Transfer、Weather Risk Management、Climate Change & Climate Risk、Protection Gap、Alternative Reinsurance Capital 等專題。除新聞外，其**數據類欄目**對精算與風險分析最有價值：**Deal Directory**（逐筆交易目錄）、**Cat Bond & ILS Market Dashboard**、**Catastrophe Bond Market Yield**、**Cat Bond Losses & Bonds At Risk**、Reinsurance Sidecars、**Longevity Swaps & Risk Transfers**、**Reinsurance Market Survey Results**、MarketView 與 ILS Fund Managers 名錄。對 RIAA：這是理解**「風險如何被資本市場化」**的第一手窗口；定價與建模側可接 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[climada-petals]]，市場與行業數據可與 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[perils-ied]] 對照，巨災模型側見 [[catmodeling]]、[[oasislmf]]；適合作 ILS、巨災風險轉移、資本管理與行業研究方向。
